name: Suzushiro Rein
source:
(25 in Memories Off 6: Next Relation)
Hobbies: Tooling, watching martial arts.
Likes: Motorcycle, drinking (alcohol).
Hates: When she skips a deadline, editors.

A novelist who is known for skipping deadlines, making her novels get delayed release.

[spoiler]Her real name is Suzu Inaho (稲穂 鈴), which makes it obvious that she is [url=/c13545]Shin[/url]'s older sister. [/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off_6:_T-wave]Wikipedia[/url].]
